protocol: Separate run after all three experimental computations completed. Float64/complex128, CPU one thread, batch1, 45 fresh worlds covering all15 ordinary cells, three random-order repeats after warming every method on every world. Includes initializer and all estimation operations, excludes model/file loading, observation generation and detector. Sparse uses frozen validation-selected settings.

inputs.generator_policy: Independent operating point RNG keys include SNR and RSR; path-regime trial offsets prevent overlap; high-SNR study may explicitly couple worlds by rescaling a fixed anchor noise realization.
